cvEn:
Itzhak Reich, son of Shoshana and Simha, was born on the 28th of Elul 5718 (13 September 1958) in Kiryat Haim. He completed his elementary schooling at the Arlozorov Elementary School in Kiryat Haim, and then attended the ORT high school, where he graduated after thirteen grades with a specialization as a precision mechanics technician. He was active in the youth movement HaNoar HaOved VeHaLomed, and he loved to play soccer.

Itzhak enlisted in the IDF in July 1978. Until 1984 he served in the Jordan Valley, and afterward he became a career soldier in the Navy in Haifa.

Itzhak Reich was a good soldier, disciplined, responsible, and devoted to his work. He earned great esteem from his commanders throughout his service.

In 1985 he married Inat, and they had two sons, Sharon and Han.

Itzhak fell while performing his duties on the 23rd of Tishrei 5750 (22 October 1989). He was brought to eternal rest in the military section of the Tzur Shalom cemetery. He is survived by his wife, his two sons, his parents, and his sister, Esther. After his death he was promoted posthumously to Sergeant Major.

In a letter of condolence to the bereaved family, the base commander wrote: "The soldiers of the unit salute at his fresh grave, remembering him as a true friend who volunteered for every task, a beautiful soul above all, and an excellent professional. His dedication, loyalty, and precision in his work and his mastery of his craft placed him in the front rank of the unit's NCOs."
